Ghostty: Surface-centered sessions
|
|-- App (src/App.zig): coordination and shared resources
|   |-- surfaces: registry of *apprt.Surface (not owned core values)
|   |-- focused_surface: checked reference; mailbox: UI dispatch queue
|   |   `-- tick -> surfaceMessage -> live Surface.handleMessage()
|   |-- font_grid_set: shared, reference-counted font grids
|   |-- device: optional shared GPU Device; lazily initialized
|   `-- deinit: runtime surfaces first, then shared fonts and device
|
`-- Runtime host (src/apprt.zig): windows / tabs / splits / panes
    |-- apprt.App / apprt.Surface: native actions and session lifecycle
    `-- Surface (src/Surface.zig): runtime-managed terminal widget
        |-- app / rt_app / rt_surface: references, not owned services
        |-- keyboard / mouse / size / focused / visible / child_exited
        |-- config: owned DerivedConfig
        |   `-- updateConfig -> derived I/O and renderer settings
        |-- font_grid_key / metrics -> App.font_grid_set
        |-- io: termio.Termio [I/O + emulation detail]
        |-- io_thread: termio.Thread manager; io_thr: OS thread
        |   `-- drains io.mailbox -> io.queueWrite / resize / config
        |-- renderer_state: renderer.State (shared access bridge)
        |   |-- terminal -> &io.terminal (NOT another terminal)
        |   `-- mutex + demand handoff; preedit and render mouse state
        |-- renderer: GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI) [frame detail]
        |   `-- borrows App.device and shared font grid
        |-- renderer_thread: manager/mailbox; renderer_thr: OS thread
        |   `-- wakeups -> renderer.updateFrame() / drawFrame()
        |-- optional search worker and terminal inspector
        |-- Input callbacks: key / text / mouse / paste
        |   |-- binding -> local operation OR rt_app.performAction()
        |   |-- encode -> io.terminal modes / keyboard / mouse protocols
        |   `-- queueIo owns messages -> io.mailbox; readonly drops writes
        |-- sizeCallback: pixels + cell metrics + padding -> Size.grid()
        |   |-- queueIo(.resize) -> coalesced Termio.resize()
        |   `-- also directly mails renderer .resize and wakes it
        |-- draw() -> renderer.drawFrame(true) on main thread
        `-- Session lifecycle
            |-- childExited: native UI or terminal text; records exit
            |   `-- normal exit: wait_after_command holds, otherwise close
            |-- close() -> rt_surface.close(needsConfirmQuit())
            `-- deinit: search, renderer, I/O workers stop and join
                |-- I/O exit -> Exec stops child and joins PTY reader
                |-- free renderer before its manager, then I/O resources
                `-- release font reference, preedit/mutex and config
